```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if(!requireNamespace("glue", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("glue", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(glue)

cal_id <- "c_6eluv1h8o830k7vt8ctcs6ghto@group.calendar.google.com"

# Calculates today's date formatted as a URL-safe text timestamp
start_bound <- URLencode(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z", tz="UTC"))

# Forces Google to dump the historical backlog and show up to 100 current/future events
url <- paste0(
  "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/", URLencode(cal_id), "/public/basic.ics",
  "?timeMin=", start_bound,
  "&maxResults=100",
  "&singleEvents=true"
)

tryCatch({
  tmp_ics <- tempfile(fileext = ".ics")
  
  if (Sys.info()[["sysname"]] == "Windows") {
    download.file(url, destfile = tmp_ics, method = "wininet", quiet = TRUE)
  } else {
    options(download.file.method = "curl", download.file.extra = "-L -k")
    download.file(url, destfile = tmp_ics, quiet = TRUE)
  }
  
  raw_lines <- readLines(tmp_ics, warn = FALSE)
  
  # Crucial for iCal: Join lines that Google wraps/folds at 75 characters
  unfolded_text <- paste(raw_lines, collapse = "\n")
  unfolded_text <- gsub("\n[ \t]", "", unfolded_text) 
  lines <- strsplit(unfolded_text, "\n")[[1]]
  
  event_starts <- which(lines == "BEGIN:VEVENT")
  event_ends   <- which(lines == "END:VEVENT")
  events_list <- list()
  
  if (length(event_starts) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_along(event_starts)) {
      ev_lines <- lines[event_starts[i]:event_ends[i]]
      summary_line <- ev_lines[grep("^SUMMARY:", ev_lines)]
      dtstart_line <- ev_lines[grep("^DTSTART([;:])", ev_lines)]
      desc_line    <- ev_lines[grep("^DESCRIPTION:", ev_lines)]
      
      if (length(summary_line) > 0 && length(dtstart_line) > 0) {
        summary_text <- sub("^SUMMARY:", "", summary_line[1])
        raw_time <- sub("^DTSTART.*:", "", dtstart_line[1])
        
        # --- Clean up the description ---
        desc_text <- ""
        if (length(desc_line) > 0) {
            desc_text <- sub("^DESCRIPTION:", "", desc_line[1])
            
            # 1. THE FOOLPROOF CHOP: 
            # Finds HTML breaks/newlines immediately followed by the boilerplate, and deletes ALL of it to the end of the string.
            desc_text <- sub("(<br>|\\\\n|\\\\N|\\s)*(Join with Google Meet|Google Meet joining info|This event has a video call|Join Zoom Meeting|-::~:~::~:~:~).*$", "", desc_text, ignore.case = TRUE)
            
            # 2. Convert any leftover iCal literal newlines to HTML breaks
            desc_text <- gsub("\\\\n|\\\\N", "<br>", desc_text)
            
            # 3. Fix escaped commas and semicolons
            desc_text <- gsub("\\\\,", ",", desc_text)
            desc_text <- gsub("\\\\;", ";", desc_text)
            
            # 4. Remove redundant time/agenda string from description if present.
            # This regex looks for patterns like "3:20 - 4 PM ET: " or "3:20pm" at the start of the description.
            desc_text <- sub("^(Agenda(<br>|\\\\n|\\\\N|\\s)*)?\\s*\\(?\\d{1,2}(:\\d{2})?(\\s*([AP]M))?(\\s*-\\s*\\d{1,2}(:\\d{2})?(\\s*([AP]M))?)?(\\s+[A-Z]{2,4})?\\)?:?(\\s*((<br>|\\\\n|\\\\N)\\s*))*", "", desc_text, ignore.case = TRUE)

            # 5. Clean up any leftover breaks or spaces at the absolute end of the newly chopped string
            desc_text <- gsub("(<br>|\\s)+$", "", desc_text)
            desc_text <- trimws(desc_text)
        }
        
        clean_time <- tryCatch({
          if (grepl("TZID=", dtstart_line)) {
            # Handles events with a specified timezone, e.g., DTSTART;TZID=America/New_York:20260827T152000
            tzid <- sub('.*TZID=([^:]+):.*', '\\1', dtstart_line)
            time_str <- sub('.*:', '', dtstart_line)
            as.POSIXct(time_str, format="%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz=tzid)
          } else if (grepl("Z$", raw_time)) {
            # Handles UTC events, e.g., DTSTART:20260827T152000Z
            t <- as.POSIXct(raw_time, format="%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", tz="UTC")
            attr(t, "tzone") <- "America/New_York"
            t
          } else {
            # Fallback for all-day events, e.g., DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20260827
            as.POSIXct(sub("T.*", "", raw_time), format="%Y%m%d", tz="America/New_York")
          }
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(clean_time)) {
          events_list[[length(events_list) + 1]] <- list(
            summary = summary_text,
            start = clean_time,
            description = desc_text
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  current_str <- format(Sys.time(), tz="America/New_York", usetz=FALSE)
  current_time_est <- as.POSIXct(current_str, tz="America/New_York")
  
  future_events <- Filter(function(x) x$start >= current_time_est, events_list)
  
  if (length(future_events) > 0) {
    future_events <- future_events[order(sapply(future_events, function(x) x$start))]
    next_event <- future_events[[1]]
    
    date_est  <- format(next_event$start, "%B %d, %Y", tz="America/New_York")
    time_est  <- format(next_event$start, "%H:%M %Z", tz="America/New_York")
    summary_txt <- next_event$summary
    desc_txt <- next_event$description
    
    # Clean time from summary text, as it's displayed separately.
    # This regex removes various time formats like "10:00am", "10-11", "(3:00 PM ET)" etc. from anywhere in the summary string.
    summary_txt <- trimws(gsub("\\s*\\(?\\d{1,2}(:\\d{2})?(\\s*([AP]M))?(\\s*-\\s*\\d{1,2}(:\\d{2})?(\\s*([AP]M))?)?(\\s+[A-Z]{2,4})?\\)?", "", summary_txt, ignore.case = TRUE))
    
    # Format description HTML (Hides completely if empty, clamps at 5 lines)
    desc_html <- ""
    if (nchar(desc_txt) > 0) {
      desc_html <- paste0('<div class="mb-4 small fims-meeting-description" style="display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 5; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;">', desc_txt, '</div>')
    } else {
      desc_html <- '<div class="mb-4"></div>' 
    }
    
    html_output <- paste0(
      '<div class="fims-pulse-side-col">',
        '<div class="fims-meeting-card">',
          '<div class="fims-meeting-content">',
            '<h3 class="no-anchor">Next Meeting</h3>',
            '<p class="mb-1 fw-bold fims-meeting-summary">', summary_txt, '</p>',
            desc_html,
            '<div class="fims-meeting-datetime">',
              '<div class="fims-meeting-row">',
                '<i class="bi bi-calendar-event-fill fims-icon-danger"></i> <strong>', date_est, '</strong>',
              '</div>',
              '<div class="fims-meeting-row">',
                '<i class="bi bi-clock-fill fims-icon-danger"></i> <strong>', time_est, '</strong>',
              '</div>',
            '</div>',
          '</div>',
          '<a href="https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=Y182ZWx1djFoOG84MzBrN3Z0OGN0Y3M2Z2h0b0Bncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t" target="_blank" class="btn btn-light fims-btn-full">Add to calendar</a>',
        '</div>',
      '</div>'
    )
    cat(html_output)
    
  } else {
    stop("No future events found")
  }
  
}, error = function(e) {
  fallback_output <- paste0(
    '<div class="fims-pulse-side-col">',
      '<div class="fims-meeting-card">',
        '<div class="fims-meeting-content">',
          '<h3 class="no-anchor">Next Meeting</h3>',
          '<p class="mb-4 fims-meeting-description">No upcoming meetings scheduled.</p>',
        '</div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  )
  cat(fallback_output)
})
```

::: {.fims-steps-section}
::: {.fims-steps-intro}
## Getting Involved
Follow these simple steps to start contributing to the FIMS project today.

![FIMS dashboard](../images/fims_dashboard.png){fig-alt="FIMS dashboard showing the project workflow and contribution steps." .fims-steps-img}
:::

::: {.fims-steps-list}
::: {.fims-step}
::: {.fims-step-number}
1
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
#### Introduce Yourself
Introduce yourself on the FIMS discussion board and start following discussions and the FIMS repository.

<a href="https://github.com/orgs/NOAA-FIMS/discussions/801" class="fims-step-link">Introduce Yourself <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i></a>
:::
:::

::: {.fims-step}
::: {.fims-step-number}
2
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
#### Go through the FIMS Vignettes
Go through the FIMS vignettes to understand the package's functionality.

<a href="https://noaa-fims.github.io/FIMS/" class="fims-step-link">Learn Now <i class="bi bi-file-text"></i></a>
:::
:::

::: {.fims-step}
::: {.fims-step-number}
3
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
#### Review Contribution Guide
Read our technical standards for contributing to FIMS.

<a href="https://github.com/NOAA-FIMS/FIMS/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md" class="fims-step-link">Read Guide <i class="bi bi-file-text"></i></a>
:::
:::

::: {.fims-step}
::: {.fims-step-number}
4
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
#### Come to Code Club and other FIMS trainings
Attend FIMS Code Clubs and trainings to learn more about contributing to FIMS and connect with other contributors. You don't need to be an expert to attend - these are meant to be welcoming spaces for learning and collaboration!

<a href="../about/calendar.html'" class="fims-step-link">Browse Calendar <i class="bi bi-people"></i></a>
:::
:::

::: {.fims-step}
::: {.fims-step-number}
5
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
#### Start Small
Pick a 'Good First Issue' on GitHub and submit your first pull request for peer review.

<a href="https://github.com/NOAA-FIMS/FIMS/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22" class="btn btn-dark fims-btn-small">Find First Issue</a>
:::
:::
:::
:::
